message.content: In the discussions surrounding the garden renovation, several proposals were made to ensure the space remains comfortable and enjoyable even when the sun is shining. One suggestion was to add a small water feature to the garden, which could not only add a soothing sound but also potentially attract wildlife. Another idea was to incorporate a shaded area, such as a pergola or umbrellas, around the seating areas. Additionally, MuradinBronzebeard suggested placing plants around the seating area to create a more natural and private setting. These solutions aim to provide a variety of amenities that cater to different preferences and needs, ensuring that the garden remains a welcoming space throughout the year.
